intent: 在 3D 场景贴文字标签
POI 升级版 (自定义颜色 / 字号)
signature: createCSS2DObject(opts?: { text?, position?, color?, bgColor?, fontSize?, size? }): CSS2DObjectHandle
code: const label = ssp.cssTool.createCSS2DObject({ text: 'A_6F', position: { x: 0, y: 50, z: 0 }, color: '#29ccff' }); console.log('css label added:', label.id);
example: const a6 = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('floorName', 'A_6F')[0]; const pos = a6 ? { x: 0, y: 50, z: 0 } : { x: 0, y: 30, z: 0 }; const label = ssp.cssTool.createCSS2DObject({ text: 'A 楼 6 层', position: pos, bgColor: '#29ccffcc', color: '#fff' }); console.log('created:', label.id);
guard: 标签用 canvas fillText 画, 不接外部 HTML (避免 SVG tainted)
标签始终面向相机 (Sprite 行为)
不需要手动 scene.add, cssTool 内部已经 add
